notes.ModItem.ModifyWeaponDamage: Shared order: ModItem, GlobalItem, ModPlayer. Finite, integer, non-negative result.
notes.ModItem.ModifyWeaponCrit: ModItem before ModPlayer. Integer result; a non-finite value becomes zero.
notes.ModItem.ModifyWeaponKnockback: ModItem before ModPlayer. Finite non-negative result.
notes.ModItem.ModifyItemScale: Acts on the queried scale and on the hitbox. Item.scale is restored after the native calculation.
notes.ModItem.CanHitNPC: undefined also keeps the game's decision. Collision is still checked. ModPlayer and ModNPC vetoes win.
notes.ModItem.ModifyHitNPC: JS contract: damage, knockBack, hitDirection, crit, SourceDamage and Knockback (StatModifier), SetCrit() and DisableCrit(). Melee; not reapplied on fromNet.
notes.ModItem.CanHitPvp: Runs on the attacker during ItemCheck_MeleeHitPVP, before status and sending damage. Validated across two processes.
notes.ModItem.ModifyHitPvp: JS contract: damage, hitDirection, quiet, crit, dodgeable. Runs on the victim, with the weapon's origin and NetSend/NetReceive carried over the network.
notes.ModItem.OnHitPvp: HurtInfo: DamageSource, Damage, HitDirection, PvP, Quiet, Crit, CooldownCounter, Dodgeable. Runs on the victim after positive damage, including when received over the network.
notes.ModItem.CanMeleeAttackCollideWithNPC: undefined also keeps the game's decision. Does not force Intersects of rectangles unrelated to the attack.
notes.ModItem.MeleeEffects: Before ModPlayer. A per-type mark avoids JavaScript dispatch for items without an override, except with a global observer.
notes.ModNPC.ModifyNPCHappiness: ExMod adaptation. Primary biome: 0 forest, 1 underground, 2 snow, 3 desert, 4 jungle, 5 ocean, 6 hallow, 7 mushroom, 8 dungeon, 9 corruption, 10 crimson. shopHelper and the neighbors are native.
notes.ModNPC.ModifyIncomingHit: JS contract: damage, knockBack, hitDirection, crit, SourceDamage and Knockback (StatModifier), SetCrit() and DisableCrit(). Not reapplied on fromNet.
notes.ModNPC.ModifyHitPlayer: JS contract: damage, hitDirection, quiet, crit and dodgeable. Does not have every field of tModLoader's HurtModifiers.
notes.ModNPC.OnHitByItem: hit has Damage, SourceDamage, Knockback, HitDirection and Crit. damageDone is the actual native return.
notes.ModNPC.OnHitByProjectile: Includes projectiles with no player owner. hit has Damage, SourceDamage, Knockback, HitDirection and Crit. damageDone is the actual native return.
notes.ModNPC.OnHitPlayer: hurtInfo has DamageSource, Damage, HitDirection, PvP, Quiet, Crit, CooldownCounter and Dodgeable.
notes.ModNPC.TownNPCProfile: Called once on the template, with content ready. Return a native ITownNPCProfile or null.
notes.ModPlayer.CatchFish: itemDrop and npcSpawn are Refs. sonar and sonarPosition are not applied to the game yet.
notes.ModProjectile.OnTileCollide: false only prevents the death caused by the collision in this movement. Expiration and NPC hits still go through Kill and OnKill.
notes.ModProjectile.PreKill: false removes the projectile without the native death effects and ends the flow before OnKill.
notes.NetWriter.Write: Writes JS values in the loader's protocol, not BinaryWriter bytes. The WriteByte, WriteInt32 etc. variants are aliases of Write.
notes.NetReader.Read: Reads in the order written by NetWriter. Throws RangeError when the message has no more values.
notes.ExtraJump.constructor: Descriptor of the native jumps. Registering new jump types is not part of the current API.
notes.PlayerDrawLayer.constructor: Base for custom layers and descriptor of the native ones. Exported classes are registered automatically; the default name is the class name.
notes.PlayerDrawLayer.SetStaticDefaults: Once with content ready, after the items and equipment are registered.
notes.PlayerDrawLayer.GetDefaultPosition: Required. Return BeforeParent or AfterParent with a native descriptor, a registered class, an instance or a full name. Default positions are cached.
notes.PlayerDrawLayer.GetDefaultVisibility: Asked on each draw and for each player. false hides the layer and its children. Check drawInfo.shadow to exclude afterimages.
notes.PlayerDrawLayer.Draw: Required. Add DrawData with ModPlayer.AddDrawData(drawInfo, drawData). Runs together with the parent, before the native transformations and rendering.
notes.PlayerDrawLayer.Hide: Hides the layer and its children in the current draw. The state is restored at the end, including in nested calls.
notes.PlayerDrawLayer.Visible: The layer's own visibility in the current draw; a hidden parent also suppresses its execution.
notes.PlayerDrawLayer.register: Manual registration for classes with Autoload=false or created at runtime. Validates Draw and GetDefaultPosition, rejects duplicates and creates the ModContent.GetInstance template.
notes.ModItem.UseAnimation: Before the native duration calculation. Shares ApplyItemAnimation with ModPlayer's modifiers.
notes.ModItem.UseItemFrame: After the complete PlayerFrame, with itemAnimation > 0. Native filter by the selected item.
notes.ModItem.HoldItemFrame: After the complete PlayerFrame, with itemAnimation <= 0 and CanVisuallyHoldItem allowed.
notes.ModItem.NeedsAmmo: false uses a temporary default ammo when there is no candidate; it is not consumed and does not enter the inventory.
notes.ModItem.CanChooseAmmo: On the weapon. false rejects; true allows another category; null/undefined follow ammo == useAmmo. The ammo's veto wins.
notes.ModItem.CanBeChosenAsAmmo: On the ammo. Combines with the weapon; any false wins. Includes vanilla weapons and native slot switching.
notes.ModItem.CanConsumeAmmo: On the weapon. false keeps the stack without preventing the shot. Combines with the ammo and ModPlayer.
notes.ModItem.CanBeConsumedAsAmmo: On the ammo. false keeps the stack and suppresses consumption notifications.
notes.ModItem.OnConsumeAmmo: On the weapon, after an actual decrement in the mobile game. Type and instance kept on the last unit, before TurnToAir.
notes.ModItem.OnConsumedAsAmmo: On the ammo, after an actual decrement. Before clearing the last unit and before ModPlayer.OnConsumeAmmo.
notes.ModItem.PickAmmo: On the ammo: item, weapon, player, type/speed/knockback (Ref) and damage (StatModifier over mobile's total damage). After the native calculation and before the notifications.
notes.ModItem.GetHealLife: Life Ref, only with a positive base healLife. ModItem before ModPlayer. QuickHeal uses the value in the selection; temporary fields restored.
notes.ModItem.GetHealMana: Mana Ref, only with a positive base healMana. quickHeal true in QuickHeal and QuickMana; ModItem before ModPlayer. Temporary fields restored.
notes.ModItem.ModifyPotionDelay: Ref of the delay already computed by the mobile game, including native reductions; there is no mobile Player.PotionDelayModifier. Before the veto and the application.
notes.ModItem.ApplyPotionDelay: false prevents the counter and PotionSickness, keeping the previous counter. Combines with ModPlayer; any veto wins. Healing and consumption go on.
notes.ModPlayer.GetHealLife: After ModItem, only with a positive base healLife. quickHeal uses a per-player context; also takes part in QuickHeal's selection.
notes.ModPlayer.GetHealMana: After ModItem, only with a positive base healMana. quickHeal true in QuickHeal and QuickMana; temporary fields restored.
notes.ModPlayer.ApplyPotionDelay: Receives the final delay after ModItem.ModifyPotionDelay. Any ModItem or ModPlayer veto prevents the counter and the buff; keeps healing and consumption.
notes.ModPlayer.AddDrawData: Reuses the native array, without allocating another array or installing hooks. Constant time and extra space.
notes.ModPlayer.ModifyDrawInfo: The mobile cache is DrawData[] with DrawDataCacheCount, not List<DrawData>. Use ModPlayer.AddDrawData(drawInfo, drawData). The entry comes before the native layers and may end up behind the player.
notes.ModSystem.ModifyWorldGenTasks: tasks is a JS array of GenPass. The native list is replaced before execution; weight and Enabled stay native. Signature of the local tModLoader copy: tasks only.
notes.ModSystem.PreWorldGen: Runs before the WorldGenerator steps, after the game builds its generation list.
notes.ModSystem.PostWorldGen: Only when the native generator returns true; does not run on a cancelled generation.
notes.ModSystem.ModifyHardmodeTasks: Mobile adaptation: a single default Hardmode Conversion step, which keeps initializeHardMode. Allows inserting, removing, reordering and disabling steps; does not expose Good/Evil/Walls separately.
notes.ModSystem.ModifyTimeRate: Three independent Refs. The clock uses double; tiles/events accumulate fractions and write mobile's integer rates. Non-finite, negative values or values above Int32.MaxValue keep the native value.
notes.ModSystem.ModifyTransformMatrix: Ref of Terraria.Graphics.SpriteViewMatrix; applied after the native zoom and before drawing.
notes.ModSystem.HijackGetData: Ref of the byte and the native BinaryReader. Position goes back to 1 between systems. true cancels the whole packet; the client/server is MessageBuffer.whoAmI. Replacing the reader copies its payload.
notes.ModSystem.HijackSendData: Any true cancels SendData and the entity envelope. whoAmI is the buffer index: remoteClient on the server's targeted send, 256 in the other cases.
notes.ModSystem.SaveWorldHeader: TagCompound in <world>.wld.bl.header.json, separate from the full data; TryGetHeaderData accepts a ModSystem instance or class. No cloud persistence.
notes.ModSystem.OnModUnload: Once on a normal exit or on the JS engine's shutdown; a forced process termination by the system does not run callbacks.
notes.ModSystem.PostSetupRecipes: After every recipe, PostAddRecipes and the rebuild of the native caches.
notes.GenPass.ApplyPass: Implement it in a JS subclass; a callback run by the native generator through PassLegacy. Callback failures are isolated.
notes.PassLegacy.ApplyPass: Calls the function given to the constructor with the native GenerationProgress and GameConfiguration.

unavailable.reason: UpdateNPC_BuffApplyDOTs accumulates and applies the damage in a local DOTTally. The damage reference is not reachable before it is applied.
The message and the color are locals of checkDead. DropTombstoneTownNPC only exposes the tombstone text.
The cooldown and its parameters live in local variables of the town NPC AI. There is no interceptable helper with the complete references.
The shot's parameters live in local variables of the town NPC AI. There is no interceptable helper with the complete references.
The hitbox parameters live in local variables of the town NPC AI. There is no interceptable helper with the complete references.
The aura parameters live in local variables of the town NPC AI. There is no interceptable helper with the complete references.
Texture, frame, scale and offsets are locals of the renderer. There is no method with all of the mutable arguments.
Texture, frame, scale and offsets are locals of the renderer. There is no method with all of the mutable arguments.
Main.DrawHealthBar does not receive the NPC and also serves players and worm segments. Matching by position or life could change the wrong entity.
The mobile renderer uses Unity, does not call FilterManager.CanCapture and has no Main.finalScreenTarget. tModLoader-compatible automatic capture was dropped.
